title: Fresh4Sunset
description: For 25 years, Fresh4Sunset has been growing strawberries in Delta, BC.
overlay_copy: For 25 years, Fresh4Sunset has been growing strawberries in Delta, BC. That experience shows in every berry: ripe, juicy, and full of just-picked flavour. Grown by Grin and Ravi Cheema for SUNSET®, these local strawberries land fresh in the Save-On-Foods produce aisle. Real strawberries, grown close to home, picked at their best.

title: Windset Farms
description: Windset Farms’ state-of-the-art greenhouse facilities deliver nutrient-rich, flavorful produce for Canadians year-round.
overlay_copy: Headquartered in Delta, British Columbia, Windset Farms' state-of-the-art greenhouse facilities deliver nutrient-rich, flavorful produce for Canadians year-round including tomatoes, peppers, cucumbers, and specialty items. With a commitment to quality, sustainability, and innovation, Windset Farms has proudly been Your Friends in Freshness® for over three decades.

title: Hillsight Vegetables Inc.
description: Hank Fousert immigrated to Yellowhead County, AB from the Netherlands in 1966, establishing Hillsight Vegetables INC.
overlay_copy: Hank Fousert immigrated to Yellowhead County, AB from the Netherlands in 1966, establishing Hillsight Vegetables INC. Currently farming Beets and Rutabagas on over 200 acres, the Fousert Family has 3 generations involved in all aspects of the business. Hillsight Vegetables INC is committed to sustainable farming for generations to come.

title: BCfresh
description: BCfresh is a grower-owned and operated company representing over 70 family farms across British Columbia
overlay_copy: BCfresh is a grower-owned and operated company representing over 70 family farms across British Columbia, primarily located in the Lower Mainland’s rich agricultural region. Together, our growers cultivate more than 7,500 acres annually, producing over 200 million pounds of fresh produce each year. That’s equivalent to more than 1 billion servings of root and field vegetables or about 35 pounds for every British Columbian.
